feeds.title: Tactical Taekwondo
feeds.description: I started Taekwondo as a chubby 16-year-old who couldn't run the length of a training hall without turning red and falling over. However, martial arts was something I desperately wanted to do. With the help of some great instructors, I finally reached black belt. Since then due to work and life changes I have left my home and I am unable to continue training with the people who set me on the path. Tactical Taekwondo is my research into those patterns and their application
